answer: Commit the receipt hash, reveal after the epoch closes. The commitment is 32 bytes, the reveal carries input, output and a signature. Three unrelated operators must confirm before payment releases, checked as a key intersection, not a vote. Recruit edges are walked to depth two, so nobody confirms its own descendant. Numbers, one receipt, three keys, a six hour reveal window, the full bond slashed on a bad reveal. A hollow identity needs 3,000 independent keys to look real, the mirror of its own keys returns nothing, and a comet of joined accounts burns out inside one epoch.
